mrs.title: Fix discount tier boundary off-by-one
mrs.description: Corrects the tier calculator so that an order of exactly 50 units receives the 15% bracket rather than 10%. Adjusts the comparison in the tier lookup and the rule evaluation order in the discount engine.

mrs.title: Include savings breakdown in order confirmation email
mrs.description: Order confirmation emails now itemise each discount applied and the total saved. Updates the confirmation template and the renderer that populates it.
